prompt: Process an employee expense report by submitting it, checking policy, reimbursing valid reports, and rejecting invalid reports.
enzo:
bpmn ExpenseBasic
start Start
task Submit "Submit expense"
gateway Policy "Within policy?"
task Reimburse "Reimburse employee"
task Reject "Reject expense"
end End

Policy -> Reimburse : yes
Policy -> Reject : no

Reject -> End

Reject --> End
